title: multi-sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics; parity + version bumps
author: Jordan Lee
description: Motivation: unify auth and retry behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; improve streaming ergonomics and bring API parity so integrations behave consistently. This PR consolidates token refresh logic, standardizes retry/backoff middleware, and introduces a small ergonomic surface for streaming clients (consistent iterator/stream interfaces and reconnect semantics). Changes include version bumps for all SDK packages to v1.214.0 and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate auth token refresh and expiry handling; - [x] Implement shared retry/backoff policy and hooks; - [x] Make streaming client APIs parity-aligned (Python iterator, TS ReadableStream wrapper, Go stream iterator); - [x] Add context/cancellation support for streaming and retries; - [x] Update docs/changelogs and add migration notes; - [x] Add unit and integration tests for auth/retry/streaming; - [ ] Deprecation: schedule removal of legacy callback-based streaming API in next major. CI: full pipeline run; initial flaky integration failure on Windows related to websocket timing was investigated and fixed by adding jitter and improved reconnect backoff. Linked Linear tasks: ENG-2142, PM-438. Breaking change: false. Migration notes: minimal changes required for most users; see release_notes for details.
commits: feat(sdk): unify auth token refresh across Python/TS/Go
feat(sdk): add shared retry middleware + exponential jitter
fix(streaming): stabilize reconnect/backoff for websocket streams
refactor(python): StreamingIterator improvements and context support
refactor(ts): export ReadableStream wrapper and typed hooks
refactor(go): introduce RetryPolicy interface and backoff implementation

docs(sdk): add migration notes for streaming ergonomics

merge_outcome: Merged after CI green and 2 approvals. Bumped package versions for Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to v1.214.0 and published artifacts.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth token refresh logic across Python/TS/Go; standard retry/backoff policy with jitter; improved streaming ergonomics and parity across languages (iterator/ReadableStream/stream iterator); minor API additions to support context/cancellation; bug fixes for websocket reconnect stability; bumped SDK versions to v1.214.0. Migration: most users need no changes; streaming clients that relied on legacy callback signatures should migrate to the new iterator/stream wrapper. See docs/sdk/migration/streaming-ergonomics.md for details.
